source64.label: Source / 64-bit
source64.prompt: Use the canonical current asset set exactly as provided.

ps2.label: PlayStation 2 Era
ps2.description: Hard conversion into early-2000s PS2-era 3D/2.5D game rendering.
ps2.prompt: FULL VISUAL RE-RENDER. Do NOT keep pixel-art rendering. Reconstruct the same subject and layout as an early-2000s PlayStation 2 action game: low-to-mid polygon 3D forms, era-authentic texture resolution, baked lighting, hard specular highlights, gritty industrial materials, slight aliasing/console-era rendering feel.

hdremaster.label: HD Remaster
hdremaster.description: Faithful high-resolution remaster of the arcade source.
hdremaster.prompt: FULL HIGH-DEFINITION REMASTER. Keep the arcade design language, but redraw all surfaces at modern HD resolution with clean edges, richer shading, sharper textures, improved lighting, anti-aliased silhouettes and polished effects. It may retain 2D sprite character logic, but must look clearly remastered rather than original pixel art.

modernStylized.label: Modern Stylized PC
modernStylized.prompt: FULL VISUAL RE-RENDER. Do NOT retain pixel-art surface treatment. Reconstruct as a modern stylized PC action game: sculpted 3D character forms, clean exaggerated shapes, high-end PBR-inspired materials, dramatic rim lighting, volumetric atmosphere, modern VFX, crisp real-time game rendering.

modernReal.label: Modern Realistic PC
modernReal.prompt: FULL VISUAL RE-RENDER. Do NOT retain pixel-art or illustrated sprite rendering. Reconstruct as a modern realistic PC action game: realistic human anatomy, realistic skin and fabric, physically based metal/concrete materials, cinematic industrial lighting, reflections, volumetric depth, realistic shadows, high-fidelity real-time rendering.

photoreal.label: Photorealistic
photoreal.description: Near-live-action photographic realism while keeping the side-view game structure.
photoreal.prompt: EXTREME STYLE TRANSFORMATION. Rebuild from scratch as photorealistic live-action-quality game imagery. Absolutely no pixel art, no cartoon linework, no painterly sprite shading. Use realistic people, photographic skin, believable fabric and hair, real industrial materials, cinematic night photography, wet-surface reflections, realistic lens/lighting while preserving the exact game composition and pose semantics.

pixar3d.label: Feature Animation 3D
pixar3d.prompt: EXTREME STYLE TRANSFORMATION. Rebuild as theatrical stylized 3D animated-feature imagery. Absolutely no pixel art. Use appealing sculpted 3D characters, expressive faces, softened but strong anatomy, clean stylized materials, rounded forms, cinematic animated-film lighting, colorful polished rendering, while preserving identity, poses, grid structure and gameplay composition.

boondocks.label: Urban Anime-Inspired Cartoon
boondocks.description: Bold urban cel-animation with sharp linework and expressive action.
boondocks.prompt: EXTREME STYLE TRANSFORMATION. Rebuild as a bold urban 2D cel-animated action cartoon with anime influence. Absolutely no pixel art and no 3D rendering. Use confident black linework, angular anatomy, expressive faces, strong silhouette design, flat/cel shadows, graphic color blocks, dynamic action posing and TV-animation clarity.

claymation.label: Claymation / Stop-Motion
claymation.description: Handmade stop-motion clay characters and miniature set.
claymation.prompt: EXTREME STYLE TRANSFORMATION. Rebuild as handcrafted stop-motion claymation. Absolutely no pixel art, no illustrated sprite shading, no realistic human photography. Characters must look physically sculpted from colored clay with fingerprints/subtle handmade surface texture; environment must look like a miniature practical set with tactile materials and miniature lighting.
